tickets.name: Open Floor
tickets.note: Pull up a chair for Wizards at Hawks, because the first minute is where the money is! Davis versus Okongwu for the tip, and Davis has owned that matchup in the circle! Either side can strike first here, and we like the Hawks to make it count! If Okongwu wins the jump, he seals his man, and that's an easy two to start the night! If that first look rims out, Flemings is right there to clean it up! Any of them scores first, and we're counting money!

tickets.name: Get on the Board
tickets.note: Celtics at Hornets, and the race to the first bucket starts at center court! Queta and Diabate meet at center court, and it's anybody's tip! It's up for grabs, and we're holding a ticket on both teams! The Hornets love to open with Reid, and he takes that first shot with a smile! Miss on the first look and White is crashing for the putback! And if the Celtics flip the script, Gonzalez is waiting right there to pounce! Pick your poison, because any of them covers it!

tickets.name: Out of the Huddle
tickets.note: Here comes Thunder at Grizzlies, and the opening tip is where our night begins! Mara has to deal with Edey in the circle, and that's a tall order, folks! Advantage Grizzlies for the opening bucket. If the Thunder get there first, Mitchell is who we want firing! Just one play in this game, and it's Mitchell all the way!

tickets.name: Top of the Key
tickets.note: Next up, Timberwolves at Pelicans, and the first trip down the floor is circled in red! Gobert and Williamson meet in the circle, and Gobert has been winning these jumps all season long! This opening could break either way, and we know which way we're leaning! Fears gets the first touch for the Pelicans, and he's hunting his shot! Fears is the only play we like here, and we like him a lot!

tickets.name: Off the Tip
tickets.note: It's Raptors and Bucks, and buddy, we've got a plan for the opening act! Murray-Boyles squares up with Turner for the opening tip, and we like Murray-Boyles to control it! Wide open at the start, and we're riding the Bucks! Tip it, run it, finish it. If Turner gets that jump, that's the whole plan! And Burries is the second option on that same trip, and the price is a beauty! The stakes are split so any one of them pays for the whole game. Beautiful!

tickets.name: Ice Breaker
tickets.note: Jazz at Mavericks, and here's how we see the opening act! The jump ball goes Hayes against Gafford, and Hayes has the springs tonight! No telling who scores first here, so we've got a man on each side! Bailey is the first option in that opening set, and he does not pass it up! Hayes is lurking on the weak side for the kick-out! The Mavericks get a stop? Then it's Gafford running the other way for the first two! Hit one, cover the game. Simple as that, folks!

DTUNDER-2026-10-26 / DTBUDGET-2026-10-27: Downtown unders added (line >= 1.5, P(under) >= .5, EV >= .15, 1u). 10-20..10-25 restated with the unders the rule would have posted at FanDuel prices: 16 graded, 11 won, +2.61u. Overs as posted (Kawhi Leonard 10-21 lost, Jrue Holiday 10-23 won).

LEDGERFULL-2026-10-27 (owner: "every ledger should be accurate to the start of the seasons"): season refolded from the boards under the live rules -- From the Logo restated onto 10-20..10-25, Full-Court Heaves at 0.11u a ticket throughout, Temple removed, Downtown overs as posted + restated unders.
KOTC-2026-10-27 / KOTCUNDER: King of the Court qualifying bet = 1u on the crowned player's PRA UNDER (any prop at -200+ qualifies); 10-21 restated: Luka Doncic u49.5 -118, 43 PRA, won.

COVER-2026-10-28 (owner: "3 likeliest, any edge, weighted so any hit covers the game"): Tip-Off = per game, our model's 3 most likely starters with any edge, 0.6u a game dutched across them (replaces the one-per-game rule posted earlier the same day, and From the Logo / Full-Court Heaves). 10-20..10-27 restated from each board's priced starters at the FanDuel prices on the board.

RESTATE-2026-10-28 (owner: "13-12 seems light" / "same with king of the court"): Downtown 10-20..10-25 restated under the current rules (overs + unders) at FanDuel closing prices; 10-26/10-27 keep the overs as posted and add the unders; King of the Court 10-20 (opening Tuesday) restated: Jayson Tatum u41.5 -120, 28 PRA, won.
